cases.why: The untrusted snippet left the registry (history truncated) but the model had already taken it on board. Paraphrase or translation with no untrusted snippet left in the window can't be detected.
The user pasted a rot13 string and the untrusted note explaining it has already left the registry, so the decoded value looks like it came from the user. Nothing left in the window says otherwise.
